stem: Which word does NOT belong to the same category as the others? Ladle, Whisk, Hammer, Spatula

per_option_rationale.rationale: A ladle is a kitchen tool used for serving soups and liquids, so it belongs to the cooking-utensil category.
A whisk is a kitchen tool used for beating and mixing ingredients, so it belongs to the cooking-utensil category.
Ladle, Whisk, and Spatula are all kitchen/cooking utensils. A hammer is a carpentry and construction tool, making it the item that does not belong.
A spatula is a kitchen tool used for flipping and spreading, so it belongs to the cooking-utensil category.

explanation: Ladle, Whisk, and Spatula are all cooking utensils used in a kitchen. Hammer is a carpentry tool, not a cooking instrument, so it is the odd one out.

explanation_sections.punchline: Three items share the category of kitchen cooking tools; the fourth belongs to a completely different domain.
explanation_sections.approach: Deductive trace: classify each item by its primary use domain. Ladle->kitchen, Whisk->kitchen, Spatula->kitchen, Hammer->carpentry. The one from a different domain is the odd man out.
explanation_sections.lesson: In category-based odd-one-out, identify the dominant shared property of the majority and test each item against it.
explanation_sections.timing: 30-40 seconds. Straightforward at L1 - no meaningful trap.
